message.text:
The s3presign runner is started by the server. It runs once immediately at startup. Then it schedules repeated execution via a 12-hour ticker.

The memopayload runner is not started as a background worker. RebuildMemoPayload is called inline from CreateMemo and UpdateMemo handlers instead.

The internal/scheduler package contains cron job infrastructure that is not used by the server.

message.text:
internal/scheduler is imported only by its own tests and is unused by the server. The server starts the s3presign runner once immediately, then schedules it again every 12 hours via time.NewTicker.

The memopayload runner is never constructed or started by the server. The webhook package spawns four async workers via init(), but these are import-time side effects rather than runners started by Server.startBackgroundRunners. The only scheduled runner the server explicitly launches is s3presign.

The s3presign runner lives in server/server.go and server/runner/s3presign/runner.go. The memopayload runner is only used on the request path, never started as a background worker.

q28.
s3presign — immediate `RunOnce` at `Server.Start`, then `time.NewTicker` every 12 hours
unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (cron) is never started; `memopayload.Runner` is never started (only `RebuildMemoPayload` on create/update)

`Server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` constructs only `s3presign.NewRunner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, `runnerInterval = 12h`). `server/runner/memopayload` exists but is not launched as a worker. `internal/scheduler` is imported only by its own tests. Webhook delivery uses `init()` queue workers in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, not a scheduled runner.
